reference: 2025 repetition of the validated 2024 external-muon ParkingSingleMuon J/psi tag-and-probe strategy

campaign_inputs.prompt_reco_policy: Use the latest PromptReco production for each 2025 era and ParkingSingleMuon primary dataset; C-v1 and F-v1 are superseded by v2.
campaign_inputs.mc_campaign_note: The 6.74-million-event 2025-conditions Bc-to-J/psi sample provides a resonant dimuon pair; the identical disjoint third-muon requirement used in data is imposed on simulation.

binning_policy: Count the same 4 eta by 5 pT grid as in 2024, then merge exactly to eta [0,0.9,1.2,2.4] and pT [5,10] for the final fit.
target_selection: looseId; miniPFRelIso_all is not part of the probe pass/fail definition
denominator: reconstructed tracker muon with 5 < pT < 10 GeV and abs(eta) < 2.4, without a LooseID or mini-isolation requirement
tag: tight muon with pT > 5 GeV; no mini-isolation or trigger-object requirement is applied to either measured J/psi leg
reference_trigger_strategy: Data must fire a ParkingSingleMuon path and contain a third tight barrel muon above 12 GeV, distinct from both J/psi legs. The identical offline topology is imposed on simulation; the HLT itself remains data-only.
adoption_gates: the 2025 golden JSON is applied to data and the 2025 pileup correction to simulation
data inputs are exclusively ParkingSingleMuon and no dimuon reference path is configured
the external reference muon is distinct from both measured J/psi legs in every selected pair
neither measured leg is trigger matched or required to pass isolation
every adopted bin has effective MC fail count >= 10, with >= 20 preferred
simultaneous pass/fail fit convergence in every adopted bin
bin-by-bin stability under signal, background, pass/fail-shape, fit-window, binning, and pileup variations
